name: TP4056 USB-C charger with protection
blurb: Charges a single Li-ion/LiPo cell from a USB-C cable at up to 1 A, and the DW01 protection chip cuts the cell off on over-discharge, overcharge and short circuit.

pins.name: IN+
pins.note: 5 V from the USB-C socket. Only needed if you power the board from wires instead of the socket.

pins.name: OUT+
pins.note: Follows the battery: 3.0 to 4.2 V, not a regulated rail. Add a boost or buck converter for 3.3 V or 5 V loads. Load current while charging reduces charge current.

pins.name: B+
pins.note: Battery positive. Connect only a single 3.7 V Li-ion/LiPo cell; never a pack of several cells.

pins.name: OUT-
pins.note: Load ground, after the protection switch. Use this for the load, not B-.

search: TP4056 USB-C 1A lithium charger module with protection

verify: Highest risk of the ten parts. Confirmed: 26 x 17 mm outline is the HW-373 style module (Botland and other sellers list it; other clones are listed at 25 x 19 and 28 x 17 mm); six pads IN+ IN- B+ B- OUT+ OUT-; OUT+/OUT- are behind the DW01A/8205 protection and B+/B- are straight to the cell; 1 A maximum charge current; protection at about 4.3 V overcharge, 2.4 V over-discharge, about 3 A overcurrent. NOT confirmed by any source opened: every pad centre (the 2 / 6 / 11 / 15 mm positions and which pad sits at which end are assumptions; read the silkscreen), PCB thickness (modelled 1.0), USB-C socket overhang, width and height, chip position. With calipers and the board in hand measure: PCB length, width and thickness, USB-C overhang and centre height, and each pad centre. Programming resistor: 1.2 kOhm = 1 A (TP4056 datasheet); a 2 kOhm part gives about 580 mA for a small cell. Do not assume 1.2 kOhm is fitted: read its marking (122). Confirm a DW01 plus 8205 protection pair is fitted; the 4-pad boards without it have no protection, and neither does a module sold with only IN and B pads. IN+ minVolts 4 is the TP4056 chip minimum; the recommended USB range is 4.5 to 5.5 V.
sources: https://dlnmh9ip6v2uc.cloudfront.net/datasheets/Prototyping/TP4056.pdf (TP4056 datasheet, opened in an earlier pass: VCC 4.0 to 8.0 V, float 4.2 V, 1.2 kOhm programs 1000 mA)

https://mischianti.org/tp4056-lipo-battery-charger-high-resolution-pinout-datasheet-and-specs/ (opened: pad pairs IN B OUT, protection table DW01A/8205 4.3 V / 2.4 V / 3 A, recommended 4.5 to 5.5 V; no dimensions)
